rules: Before you post your first clip, review these requirements. Videos that don't meet every requirement won't be approved for payout. | Content may be sourced from any video, stream or clip featuring at least 2 CORE members. | Videos can only be posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X. | Audience must be at least 50% native English-speaking countries (USA, CA, AU, UK, NZ). | Your caption/text overlay must mention CORE or any of the CORE members names. | Your captions must use the hashtag: #CORE and hashtags for each CORE member in the video. | Logos of any kind are not allowed. | No collab posts (multiple accounts that are irrelevant tagged as a collab) | No non-English captions or text. | No Repetitive/Non Content Matching Thumbnails & Japanese Captions/Descriptions. | Core YouTube content is not allowed in the 20K Core Campaign and must be submitted to the 5K Campaign. | If you don't already have a relevant clipping page with 100+ followers, we strongly recommend setting up a dedicated CORE clipping account. | Tag US locations only when relevant to the content.
